label: E-9: permitted workplace changes during the base employment period
appliesTo: Employment Permit System workers on E-9, and their employers
why: Usually compressed to 'five moves in a lifetime', which gets both halves wrong. The allowance is split between the base period and the extension, and changes forced by circumstances outside the worker's control — closure, breach of working conditions, unfair treatment — need not be counted at all. The reason for the move is therefore examined before the tally is, and a worker who believes they are out of moves may not be.

history.source: Act on the Employment of Foreign Workers, art. 25
history.note: Three changes as a rule during the base employment activity period and a further two during the extended period. Changes for statutory reasons not attributable to the worker — the employer terminating or refusing to renew, suspension or closure of business, breach of working conditions, unpaid wages or unfair treatment — may fall outside the count.
